{{Top|leg}}
An '''armored subdermal hide''' was a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implant. It provided the individual with a resistance to both energy weapon and physical attacks. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sibarra]] was outfitted with an armored subdermal hide.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
